data.gender_notes: Khanindra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khanindra is a compound name derived from 'Khan' meaning lord and 'Indra' meaning the king of gods. It signifies power, leadership, and wisdom. It is a name for a ruler or a powerful leader in Hindu mythology. The name Khanindra carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Khanindra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Khanindra is a divine name representing the supreme power and wisdom of the universe. It signifies the ability to rule over one's own destiny and to lead others with compassion and wisdom.
data.etymology: Khanindra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khanindra total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
